verdict.rationale: Git amend and commit-undo are a fair question for a Unix-like terminal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, commits, amend, or reset. Listed commands and packages cover languages, Vim, TeX, zip and ffmpeg, but no git tooling.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can amend the latest commit or undo unpushed commits to fix or split them
